description: Fail-closed component and operating-system evidence that cannot be honestly derived from a product adapter observation alone.

requirements.acceptance: The exact vendored cminpack source and Sage.js host adapter execute success, callback failure, cancellation, allocation failure, and repeated lifecycle workloads under each sanitizer with no finding.

The exact vendored NLopt source and Sage.js host adapter execute both qualified algorithms, constraints, callback failure, cancellation, allocation failure, and repeated lifecycle workloads under each sanitizer with no finding.

Authenticated cminpack and NLopt reactors fail closed on every injected fault, release all contexts/handles/allocations/bytes, expose no private callback or resource details, and remain reusable after recovery.

The qualification collector authenticates operating-system process-tree peak memory for the exact browser executable while running the bounded memory workload; browser-heap counters are supplemental and cannot substitute for process-tree evidence.
